body.message:
Good morning Hanan,

I hope you’re doing well. We truly appreciate you staying with us.

Unfortunately, we have received another booking for the apartment, so we are unable to extend your stay beyond 14th September. However, we can extend your stay until 14th September if that works for you.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. We hope to see you again soon. Thank you!
